edges.reason: msg.sender is emitted as the sender of the Deposit event in the payable fallback
msg.sender flows into submitTransaction which implicitly confirms via confirmTransaction using msg.sender
msg.sender is checked by ownerExists and used as the confirmations mapping key
msg.sender is checked by ownerExists/confirmed and used to revoke confirmation state
msg.sender must satisfy ownerExists and confirmed before any external call is executed
submitTransaction calls addTransaction and uses its returned id
submitTransaction calls confirmTransaction(transactionId) after adding
confirmTransaction calls executeTransaction(transactionId)
executeTransaction gates the call on isConfirmed(transactionId)
executeTransaction performs the low-level external call unsafe operation
the unsafe low-level call is implemented inside external_call
the external callee re-enters executeTransaction while the executed flag is still being finalised
addTransaction performs the transactionCount += 1 increment operation
the unchecked increment writes the transactionCount state variable
addTransaction reads transactionCount to derive the new transaction id
addTransaction stores a new Transaction struct into the transactions mapping
